name: Thessaloniki Port Authority Societe Anonyme
summary: Thessaloniki Port Authority Societe Anonyme offers transportation services in Greece. The company operates through five segments: Container Terminal, Conventional Cargo, Passenger Traffic, Exploitation of Sites, and Intermodal. It provides unitized cargoes; conventional cargoes, such as bulk, general, and RO-RO; coastal and cruise passengers; vessels, including anchoring, mooring, berthing, and other services; and intermodal transport services. The company also operates car parking stations. It serves vesselping agents, industrial companies, container transportation companies, and freight transport companies.
